status: DRAFT-1 2026-10-27 — product scope is all backgrounds and all fields (D10). Completeness is audited against the W-20 gold standard (V-C6-4: share of requirements that map to no category, per CIP family); the user confirms only the Taiwan course-name mapping examples (W-61).
note: Categories describe WHAT a requirement asks for, not how a school words it. Program requirement text is quoted verbatim in RequirementItem.text; mapping text or a student's course to a category is A-C6-2 / B-C6-2.

course.programming_intro: First programming course (e.g. Python, Java, C)
course.studio_art: Studio art (drawing, painting, sculpture) beyond design foundations
course.physiology_or_health_science: Health science courses beyond anatomy and physiology (e.g. microbiology, nutrition)

test.licensing_exam: Professional licensing exam (e.g. nursing, bar, engineering)

language.other_language: Proficiency in a language other than English

portfolio.audition: Audition or performance recording (music, theatre, dance)

credential.bachelor_degree: Accredited bachelor's degree (any field unless stated)
credential.bachelor_equivalency: Evaluation that the degree equals a U.S. four-year bachelor's (e.g. junior college + two-year technical bachelor, three-year degrees, foreign degrees); follow the program's stated evaluation method (B-C6-5)

other.prerequisite_program: Completion of a specific preparatory or bridge program
